name: codegraph-ide-vscode
description: Python-first codebase intelligence extension for VS Code and Cursor.

codegraph.modelAccess.useBuiltInAgent.markdownDescription: Use **built-in Cursor/Claude agent** for ALL generative work (explanation + enrichment). No API key. Recommended for subscription plans. Mutually exclusive with API key provider.

codegraph.modelAccess.useApiKeyProvider.markdownDescription: Use an **API key provider** for ALL generative work (explanation enrichment in-panel). Requires `codegraph.enrichment.apiKey` or `OPENAI_API_KEY`. Mutually exclusive with built-in agent.

codegraph.modelAccess.autoEnrichOnExplai.markdownDescription: When built-in agent mode is on, automatically hand off enrichment + explanation to the agent after Explain Selection.

codegraph.enrichment.enabled.description: Legacy: enable optional model-backed explanation enrichment.

codegraph.enrichment.preferIdeHost.description: When API key mode is on, try IDE host language models (vscode.lm) before the API key provider.

codegraph.enrichment.apiKey.description: API key for OpenAI-compatible enrichment provider (only used when Use API Key Provider is enabled).

codegraph.enrichment.baseUrl.description: Base URL for the OpenAI-compatible enrichment provider.

codegraph.enrichment.model.description: Model name used for API key enrichment.

scripts.package: npm run bundle && mkdir -p ../../artifacts && npx --yes @vscode/vsce package --no-dependencies --out ../../artifacts/codegraph-extension.vsix
